_comment: One gate per zone. Every answer is findable in the content the diver just scrolled past - that is the whole point. The quiz tests whether you read the descent, which is what makes the badge worth more than the toll.
_salts: Salts are placeholders. Generate real ones on the day (cast keccak or crypto.randomUUID) and set answerHash in the constructor. Never commit the real salts alongside the answers in a public repo - not that it saves you; see DESIGN.md, 'Known limitation'.
_hash: answerHash[zone] = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(zone, answer, salt)) where answer is the exact option string.

gates.question: You are at 200 m, the floor of the sunlight zone. What stops here?
gates.because: Below 200 m there is not enough light to grow anything. Everything deeper is eating what fell from above.

alternate.question: How deep was the deepest scuba dive ever recorded?

gates.question: Roughly what share of animals in the twilight zone make their own light?
gates.because: There is just enough light here to be seen by something hunting you, so nearly everything here has learned to control light of its own.

alternate.question: Every night, the animals of this zone do something that is the largest of its kind on Earth. What?

gates.question: You passed a wreck at 3,800 m. Which one?
gates.because: The Titanic sits at about 3,800 m, roughly twelve King Power Mahanakhons below the surface.

alternate.question: What is the water temperature through most of the midnight zone?

gates.question: What is marine snow?
options: The falling remains of everything that died above
gates.answer: The falling remains of everything that died above
gates.because: Nothing grows down here. Every meal on the abyssal plain fell from the sunlight zone, four kilometres up.

alternate.question: Abyssal plains cover more of the Earth's surface than what?

gates.question: The deepest fish ever filmed was recorded at 8,336 m. What happens below that?
options: No fish at all - it is close to the physiological limit
gates.answer: No fish at all - it is close to the physiological limit
gates.because: There appears to be a hard limit for fish near 8,200 to 8,400 m. The bottom 2,500 m of the ocean belongs to amphipods and single cells.

alternate.question: Who reached the bottom of the Challenger Deep first, and when?
